policy.normal_monster_scope: Frame omissions only; preserve all normal art

rules: Preserve full original PNG/SHA and source phase order
Use exact whole-pose regions, never cut fixed cells through a body
Require disjoint owned regions; no foreign bodies or ambiguous fragments
Apply existing alpha16/alpha100 ownership proof for eligible six-pose sources
Retain genuinely merged bodies and outer-edge truncation as HOLD; no guard relaxation

actors.name: 테베 아누비스
actors.design_basis: Dedicated newly painted original interpretation of named boss and existing DB body archetype; no claim of extracting original game art.

One broad gold khopesh sword in anatomical RIGHT hand, LEFT hand empty. No wings or human helmet.
